{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the QA orders exist
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Now check the revenue column type and sample
print(f"Revenue dtype: {sales['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample of revenue strings: {sales['revenue'].sample(10).tolist()}")

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if the conversion worked
print(f"First 5 converted revenues: {sales['revenue_float'].head().tolist()}")

# Now filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Drop the QA orders from the filtered data
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (after removing QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
